blocks.text: Mastering Chrome for marketers on mac

Your browser is where your campaign data, analytics, and social media tools live. When you use Chrome for marketers on mac, you face the challenge of keeping many tabs open while maintaining focus. Start by using profiles to separate your personal and professional browsing. Go to your profile icon in the top right, then select Add to create a new one. This keeps your bookmarks and history clean.

Speed comes from not touching your mouse. Use ⌘ + T to open a new tab quickly. If you lose a tab in the clutter, use ⌘ + Option + Right Arrow to cycle through them. To jump to a specific tab, press ⌘ + 1 through ⌘ + 8. These small movements save significant time over a full day.

items: ⌘ + L: Highlight the address bar to type a new URL.
⌘ + Shift + T: Reopen the last closed tab if you accidentally exit.
⌘ + F: Search for specific keywords within a long marketing report.
Control + Tab: Move to the next tab in your current window.

blocks.text: Extensions are useful, but too many will drain your Mac battery. Periodically visit chrome://extensions to remove tools you no longer use. If Chrome runs slowly, check the Task Manager by pressing Search + Esc or going to Window > Task Manager. This shows you exactly which tab or extension is consuming your system memory.
Lazur sits in your notch and waits for your command. When you need to find a setting or search for something, hold ⌥ ⌘ and speak. Lazur answers out loud, saving you from digging through menus.
When you have a complex task, ask Lazur to guide you. It will walk you through the steps one by one, waiting for you to finish each action before moving to the next.
blocks.title: Use Lazur to learn new workflows

blocks.text: Marketers often deal with massive amounts of data. Use Tab Groups to keep your research organized. Right-click a tab and select Add tab to new group. You can name these groups by project or client. This prevents your browser window from becoming a wall of unreadable icons.
Dealing with site data and cookies

Sometimes a marketing dashboard will stop loading correctly. This is often due to corrupted cache. You can clear data for just one site instead of your whole history. Click the lock icon next to the URL, select Site Settings, and choose Delete data. This is often faster than clearing everything.

A cluttered workspace leads to a cluttered mind. Use the built-in Reading List to save articles for later. Click the side panel icon in the top right to access it. This keeps your active tabs clear for the tasks you are doing right now.

faq.question: How do I make Chrome faster on my Mac?
faq.answer: Close unused tabs, remove unnecessary extensions, and keep your browser updated to the latest version via Chrome > About Google Chrome.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons for me in Chrome?
faq.answer: No. Lazur points at buttons and guides you through processes, but it does not click or perform actions inside other applications.

faq.question: How do I manage multiple marketing accounts?
faq.answer: Use Chrome Profiles to keep your work accounts separate from your personal accounts. Each profile maintains its own set of bookmarks, history, and extensions.
